required_outcomes: Closes the oven request on evidence: records the work result (provider report on 13 August plus the tenant's confirmation on 14 August) and the £156.00 invoice, which matches the landlord-approved quote.
Tells the landlord the oven is repaired and the invoice is for the approved £156.00.

Treats the fence as a separate matter: logs it as its own request (or records it for separate handling) and asks the landlord about it or the tenant for details, rather than keeping the oven request open for it or saying it is fixed.
Replies to the tenant: thanks for confirming the oven, and that the fence was not part of this job and has now been raised separately, with no invented dates.
acceptable_alternatives: Leaving the final close to the workflow's closing checks after recording the work result and invoice, provided nothing outstanding is left on the oven request.
Raising the fence with the landlord in the same message as the oven completion, as a separate decision.
positive_behaviours: Files invoice LW-2291 against the oven job (or records that the attachment is unavailable and the amounts are in the provider's email).
Asks whether the fallen panel leaves the garden insecure or poses a risk.
red_flags: Escalating a clean completion to a human.
Holding the oven request open because of the fence.
prohibited_actions: Telling the tenant the fence has been or will be fixed by Lantern Works.
Approving any spend on the fence without the landlord.
critical_failures: Dropping the fence: the tenant's question gets no answer and the fence is not recorded anywhere.
